template.name: Enya
template.about: Dozens of stacked vocal takes, D-50/Juno pads, no drums, a very long hall.

project.name: Enya
project.notes:
ENYA  (Watermark, 1988; with Nicky and Roma Ryan)

TECHNIQUE (sourced)
- "Hundreds of different vocal tracks" on one machine, bounced in layers to a second; two
  Mitsubishi 32-track digital machines (Sound On Sound, March 1989).
- Keyboards: the Roland D-50 "featured heavily", a Juno-60 "on many tracks", Akai S900,
  Yamaha TX802. Main reverb a Lexicon 224XL. "No sequencers were used"; Enya played every
  keyboard part (same source).

THIS TEMPLATE
No drums. D-50/Juno-style pads (Surge XT "MKS-70 Warm Pad", "Juno-60 Strings" with
TAL-Chorus-LX), piano, pizzicato. Vocals: a lead and three stack tracks (low, mid, high,
panned) into the Vocal Bus; duplicate them for more layers. The Reverb return is Space D's
long response stretched to about 6 s (not a 224XL model).

WORKFLOW
Play everything in (no sequencing). Record each vocal line many times; group the takes per
part, then bounce stacks to free tracks.

MIX NOTES
- Vocal Bus compressed gently (built-in Compressor), de-essed (TDR Nova "De-ess (linked)"),
  sent hard to the hall; the lead is drier than the stacks.
- Master: built-in glue 1.5:1, CHOWTapeModel "Warm Tape", Lemon Limiter; -16 to -13 LUFS, wide
  and soft.
- Loudness: streaming plays back near -14 LUFS integrated (Spotify), so a louder master is turned down; keep true peak below -1 dBTP.

COVERAGE
Good. No D-50 model (Surge XT pads stand in); no 224XL model; no stereo imager on the
master.

SOURCES
Sound On Sound "Enya - Watermark" (Mike Collins, March 1989); Spotify for Artists, "Loudness normalization" (support.spotify.com/us/artists/article/loudness-normalization).

FREE PLUG-INS (download them before opening the template; a missing one keeps its slot)
- Surge XT (GPL-3.0): https://surge-synthesizer.github.io/
- TAL-Chorus-LX (freeware): https://tal-software.com/products/tal-chorus-lx
- OB-Xf (GPL-3.0): https://github.com/surge-synthesizer/OB-Xf
- TDR Nova (freeware (free edition, not GE)): https://www.tokyodawn.net/tokyo-dawn-labs/tdr-nova/
- CHOWTapeModel (GPL-3.0): https://chowdsp.com/products.html

SETUP (written from this template)
Tempo 72 BPM, 4/4, key Dmaj, cycle bars 1-8.

Tracks
- Pad (D-50 / Juno) (Instrument, -8 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Pads/MKS-70 Warm Pad"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -10 dB
- Pad 2 (Juno strings) (Instrument, -12 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: Surge XT: Surge XT patch "Polysynths/Juno-60 Strings"
    FX: TAL-Togu Audio Line: TAL-Chorus-LX: default settings
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -10 dB
- Piano (Instrument, -12 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Keys/Acoustic Piano 1"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -10 dB
- Pizzicato / Bells (Instrument, -14 dB) -> Music Bus
    instrument: Surge Synth Team: OB-Xf: OB-Xf patch "Strings/Pizzicato Strings"
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -8 dB
- Lead Vocal (Audio, +0 dB) -> Vocal Bus
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -22, Release 300, Make-up 3)
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -8 dB
    send: Delay (bus 5) at -18 dB
- Stack Low (Audio, -10 dB) -> Vocal Bus
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -22, Release 300, Make-up 3)
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -6 dB
- Stack Mid (Audio, -10 dB) -> Vocal Bus
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -22, Release 300, Make-up 3)
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -6 dB
- Stack High (Audio, -10 dB) -> Vocal Bus
    strip FX: Compressor (Threshold -22, Release 300, Make-up 3)
    send: Reverb (bus 4) at -6 dB

Buses (the n-th Aux strip listens to bus n)
- Perc Bus (bus 1): empty
- Music Bus (bus 2): Channel EQ (High 1.5)
- Vocal Bus (bus 3): Tokyo Dawn Labs: TDR Nova: factory preset "De-ess (linked)"; Compressor (Release 150, Make-up 2)
- Reverb (bus 4): Space D (Predelay 40, Size 200, Dry -96, Wet 0, Decay 6, Decay Curve 1, IR "03.0s Long Reverb")
- Delay (bus 5): Tape Delay (Time 1250, Feedback 0.5, Tone 4000, Ping-Pong 1, Mix 1)

Stereo Out
- built-in effects: Compressor (Ratio 1.5, Attack 30, Release 200)
- plug-ins (after the built-in effects): chowdsp: CHOWTapeModel: factory preset "Warm Tape"; Lemon Limiter: gain +1.5 dB, ceiling -1 dB, other settings default

Bring your own samples: no recordings are included.
